facts.business: Shanti Spintex Limited is a denim fabric manufacturing company engaged in the manufacture of a diverse range of denim fabrics catering to the fashion and apparel value chain.

auditor.name: M/s HDS & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Secretarial Audit Report does not contain any qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer of opinion.

key_risks: Volatility in cotton and other raw material prices
Fluctuations in energy and processing costs
facts.related_party_note: All contracts or arrangements entered into by the Company with related parties during the financial year were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. The particulars of contracts or arrangements with related parties referred to under Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013, in the prescribed Form AOC-2, are annexed to this Report as Annexure – E. The details of related party transactions, as required under the applicable Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), are disclosed in the notes forming part of the Financial Statements.
